<div class="docSubContent">

   <div id="docSubImgWrapper" data-setting="userPref-viewMode-pub-sjj-systemPreferred-html">
      
         
            <div id="docSubImgHTML" class="docSubContent current " data-show-on-open=".jsHideForDocSubVideo">
               
                  <div class="textSizeIncrement">

<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="50001010" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/philippians/1/#v50001010" target="_blank">Philippians 1:10</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>How great our need today for discernment,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">To know the things that are true,</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">To know which things have greater importance,</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">To know which things we must do!</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp">Love what is good; Hate what is bad.</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sz">Make God’s heart glad;</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sp">Oh, what rich blessings it brings when we learn,</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sz">When we discern,</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">And when we do the important things!</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>And what could be of greater importance</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sz">Than sharing Kingdom good news,</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sp">To search for those who hunger for truth</p>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sz">And to help them God’s way to choose?</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">Love what is good; Hate what is bad.</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">Make God’s heart glad;</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sp">Oh, what rich blessings it brings when we learn,</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">When we discern,</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sp">And when we do the important things!</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3. </span>If we take care to do what’s important,</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sz">Then true contentment we’ll find.</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">The peace surpassing all understanding</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">Will guard our heart and our mind.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sp">Love what is good; Hate what is bad.</p>
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 sz">Make God’s heart glad;</p>
<p id="p31" data-pid="31" class="p31 sp">Oh, what rich blessings it brings when we learn,</p>
<p id="p32" data-pid="32" class="p32 sz">When we discern,</p>
<p id="p33" data-pid="33" class="p33 sp">And when we do the important things!</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p34" data-pid="34" class="p34 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19097010" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/97/#v19097010" target="_blank">Ps. 97:10;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="43021015-43021017" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/john/21/#v43021015-v43021017" target="_blank"> John 21:15-17;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="50004007" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/philippians/4/#v50004007" target="_blank"> Phil. 4:7</a>.)</p>
</div>
<p id="p35" class="displayNone"> </p>
